items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that already reads as dry.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream to support comfort and a smoother look, given the low moisture score.
A tinted mineral SPF 50 gives daily sun protection and blends well on deeper skin tones without a chalky cast.

response.routine_note: I've left the facial wax strips out because skin during isotretinoin can be very fragile and waxing may lift or tear it, so please ask your prescriber or a dermatologist about safer options for your upper lip. Use the cleanser and cream morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning.
